turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not speak of such things, my wife. You will be better soon, and we will see our son wed in good health.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My husband, I see clearly the path ahead. There is no denying what my body tells me. I only wish for peace of mind, knowing my son is secure.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest assured. I will take care of everything as you wish. I will find a way to secure our future and honor your last wishes.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, listen well. After I am gone, do not let the beauty and youth of your wife distract you from your duties. She must bear sons for the family line to continue.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, do not worry. Our son will heed your words and our family will thrive. You must rest now and regain your strength.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know your heart, my son, and I have faith in you. But remember, the future of our bloodline rests on the shoulders of your wife. She must be a pillar of strength for you.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest, you must focus on healing. Your son and his wife will uphold the family's honor. Do not doubt their commitment.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I see your determination, Wang Lung, and I am comforted. Yet, my son, let not the burden of my last words weigh heavy on your heart. Focus on the future and the life that will continue after me.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My love, your words touch my heart deeply. But now is not the time for burdens. Rest and know that your wishes shall be carried out with all our might.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I understand your words, Wang Lung, but my heart is heavy. I must see my son wed and then I may rest.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My love, I promise that your son shall be wed and that your final wishes will be honored. Rest now, for your health is our greatest concern.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am grateful for your words, Wang Lung, but my time grows short. I must see my son wed before my strength fails me.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, let us not dwell on the passing of time. Focus on the joy of your son's wedding. I shall see to it immediately.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I thank you, Wang Lung, but my heart cannot rest until I see my son's marriage. I ask that you make this happen swiftly.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest, your wish is my command. I shall arrange the wedding at once and ensure it is a day of great joy and celebration.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I shall prepare everything for the wedding with all my diligence, my lady and master. May the day be bright and full of joy.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please rest easy. Father and the maid will ensure everything is perfect for my wedding. I will do my best to make you proud.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My love, do not worry. The wedding shall be splendid, and you shall see your son's happiness with your own eyes. Rest now, and let us all work to make this day memorable.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, all of you. I shall rest now, knowing that my son's happiness is near. May the gods bless this day.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will see to it that everything is prepared. Sleep now, my love, and dream of the joy to come.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]
